title: Perpetual check by a cannon battery that the checking move itself completes
rationale: The cannon on g5 never moves: Red's horse alternately arrives on d5 to become its screen and then leaves d5 so that Black's own horse on f5 becomes the screen, so every red move delivers check along rank 5 while Black never checks. Pins that a check completed by the moving piece's effect on a cannon battery counts exactly as a check by the moving piece does, so the unilateral violation is complete at the third occurrence and the checking side (Red) loses.
